name: payment_details
description: 指定订单的支付收退款事实，最多100行，检查limited。
cypher: MATCH (p:payment) WHERE p.order_id IN $order_ids RETURN p.payment_id AS payment_id,p.order_id AS order_id,p.payment_amount AS payment_amount,p.paid_at AS paid_at,p.refund_amount AS refund_amount,p.refund_at AS refund_at,p.payment_status AS payment_status LIMIT 100

name: payment_attempts
description: 指定订单的支付尝试与失败原因。
cypher: MATCH (a:payment_attempt) WHERE a.order_id IN $order_ids RETURN a.attempt_id AS attempt_id,a.order_id AS order_id,a.attempt_no AS attempt_no,a.status AS attempt_status,a.amount AS attempted_amount,a.failure_code AS failure_code LIMIT 100
